data.name: Heeymah
data.gender_notes: Heeymah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Heeymah is a name derived from the Arabic language, which means 'Mother of the Believers'. In Islamic history, this name was given to Aisha bint Abu Bakr As-Siddiq, who was the wife of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and one of the greatest female companions of the Prophet. The name Heeymah symbolizes the strength and devotion of a mother who raises her children in the way of Allah and instills Islamic values in them.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of a devoted mother in Islam
data.etymology: Heeymah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mother of the Believers.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Heeymah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
